newsitem.title: USA: API, EIA, AGA weekly reports due Thurs.
newsitem.headline: API, EIA, AGA weekly reports due Thurs.

text.p: The American Petroleum Institute said it would issue its weekly petroleum report for the week ending December 20 on Thursday after 1600 EST instead of Tuesday.
For the week ending December 27, API will release its report Thursday, January 2. The reports are being released later than normal due to the Christmas and New Year holidays.

The Energy Information Administration said it would release its report for the week ending December 20 on Thursday, December 26 at 1700 EST, and for the week ending December 27 on Thursday, January 2 at the same time.
EIA normally issues its weekly petroleum status report on Wednesday mornings.

The American Gas Association said it would release its weekly natural gas storage report for the week ending December 20 on Thursday after 1600 EST instead of the regular Wednesday, and would issue its report for the week ending December 27 on Thursday, January 2.
